A written procedure applies, incidents are logged, investigated and reported to the board and funders as required, lessons change controls and the board gets an annual summary

evidence.requirement: Incident procedure and the incident log, including nil returns.

questions.text: Women make up a meaningful share of the people who decide which enterprises we select.
anchors: No women on selection decisions, or there is no panel
Women are under 20 percent of the panel
Women are 20 to 29 percent of the panel
Women are 30 to 39 percent of the panel
Women are 40 percent or more of the panel

evidence.requirement: Panel lists for the last two selection rounds.

questions.text: Each year we review our selection, curriculum and mentoring for barriers facing women and young people, such as timing, venue, childcare or biased scoring.
anchors: No review of barriers
Informal discussion only
A review was done once with no changes
An annual written review finds barriers and at least one change was made
An annual written review finds barriers with participant input, at least one change was made and its effect was checked in the next cohort
questions.riskTag: No review for gender or youth barriers

evidence.requirement: Latest barrier review and the changes made.

questions.text: We set written targets for women and young people in each cohort and report against them.
anchors: No targets
A verbal aim only
Targets are set for some programmes and not reported
Written targets for every programme are reported to the board each year
Written targets for every programme are reported to the board each year, and corrective action was recorded after the last cohort that missed a target

evidence.requirement: Targets and the latest report against them.

questions.text: We compare outcomes such as revenue, jobs and finance raised for women and men and for different age groups each year.
anchors: Outcomes are never split by gender or age
Participation counts are split but outcomes are not
Outcomes are split for one indicator in the last year
Revenue, jobs and finance outcomes are split by gender and age each year in a written analysis
Revenue, jobs and finance outcomes are split by gender and age each year in a written analysis, and a documented change in support was made to close a gap found
questions.riskTag: Results not split by gender or age

evidence.requirement: The latest outcome analysis by gender and age.

questions.text: We help entrepreneurs assess the climate and environmental risks and opportunities in their businesses.
anchors: Not covered in our programmes
Mentioned in a session only
A climate or environment module is offered to some participants
Every entrepreneur completes a climate and environmental risk check as part of the diagnostic or plan
Every entrepreneur completes a climate and environmental risk check as part of the diagnostic or plan, actions are tracked and the share adopting at least one measure is reported
questions.riskTag: Climate risk not addressed with enterprises

evidence.requirement: Programme materials and completed risk checks for the last cohort.

questions.text: We screen enterprises we promote or link to finance for serious environmental or social harm, and decline or set conditions where we find it.
anchors: No screening
Informal judgement only
A screening question is on the application but not acted on
A written exclusion list and checklist are used before promotion or finance linkage
A written exclusion list and checklist are used before promotion or finance linkage, decisions are logged and conditions are followed up

evidence.requirement: Screening policy and completed screens linked to introductions.

questions.text: We can call on climate and environment expertise through staff, mentors or partners, such as universities or specialist agencies, when entrepreneurs need it.
anchors: No access to such expertise
Occasional personal contacts only
Expert partners are named with no agreement
At least one written agreement or expert roster was used in the last 12 months
At least one written agreement or expert roster was used in the last 12 months, the expertise served several enterprises and feedback was recorded

examples: MoU with a university or agency
evidence.requirement: Expert roster or partnership agreements and records of use.

questions.text: We track climate or environmental results, such as the number of enterprises adopting resource efficient or climate smart practices.
anchors: No tracking
Anecdotes only
Tracked for a few enterprises in one cohort
An indicator is defined and tracked across all cohorts in the last 12 months
An indicator is defined and tracked across all cohorts in the last 12 months and reported to funders with baseline and follow up data

evidence.requirement: Indicator definition and data for the last 12 months.

questions.text: We reach rural entrepreneurs through design choices such as location, language and delivery method, not only through open calls.
anchors: Open calls only, with all activity in the capital or a regional city
Rural applicants are welcome but nothing in the design changed
Some rural outreach, but sessions still require travel to the city
Delivery in district or community locations, local languages and low data options is planned in the design
Delivery in district or community locations, local languages and low data options is planned in the design, rural entrepreneurs helped design it and results are reviewed by location

evidence.requirement: Programme design showing rural delivery choices and the locations used.

questions.text: We know what share of our participants are based outside the regional capital and compare it with a written target or the spread of enterprises in our area.
anchors: Participant location is not recorded
Location is recorded but the share is not calculated
The share is calculated with no target or comparison
The share is compared with a written target or local enterprise spread and reviewed yearly
The share is compared with a written target or local enterprise spread and reviewed yearly, and action was taken in the last 12 months where it fell below target

evidence.requirement: Client database location data and the target or comparison document.

questions.text: We reduce cost and access barriers for participants, such as transport, data costs, fee waivers or accessible venues.
anchors: Participants bear all costs and venues are not accessible
Occasional help is given on request
Support covers some costs in some programmes
A written support budget covers transport or data costs and venues are accessible to people with disabilities
A written support budget covers transport or data costs and venues are accessible to people with disabilities, use is tracked and drop outs for cost reasons are reviewed

evidence.requirement: Support budget lines, venue checks and drop out records.

questions.text: We share our curriculum, tools or findings with other support organisations or policy makers.
anchors: Nothing is shared
We share informally on request only
Something was shared once in the last 12 months
At least two sharing activities in the last 12 months, such as open materials, ecosystem meetings or policy briefs
At least two sharing activities in the last 12 months, such as open materials, ecosystem meetings or policy briefs, with evidence that others adopted our tools or findings
questions.riskTag: Learning not shared with the ecosystem

evidence.requirement: Records of sharing activities in the last 12 months.
